summary: The proposal outlines semantics, implementation feasibility, and seeks feedback on whether to use SPIP or a normal JIRA + PR, and whether to include Python UDAF support initially. The discussion proposes adding an OIDC credential propagation mechanism for Spark on Kubernetes, enabling per-workload access control to cloud storage by introducing a CredentialProvider SPI that uses OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange. The proposal introduces a unified API and execution protocol for user-defined functions that work across multiple programming languages, enabling Spark to run UDFs outside the engine via inter-process communication. Szehon Ho proposes a 4.2.1 maintenance release to include SPARK-59572, a correctness fix for DSv2 PartitionPredicate evaluation, along with 99 PRs covering 97 issues across SQL, Core, Streaming, PySpark, and Kubernetes.
